pure-announcement.rationale: This is Cloudflare's own promotional landing page — feature bullets, a customer testimonial and infrastructure boasts — the vendor's own pitch rather than coverage of a technique, and every claim is about what AI Gateway does, none teaching an idea a reader could apply without the product.

duplicate.rationale: Proxy-boundary-session-capture covers crash-safe session recording at a proxy, not the commercial control-plane bundle (caching, dynamic routing, unified billing) this page describes.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The capability claims are checkable against the product's public documentation and by using the gateway itself.

durability.rationale: It is a vendor feature matrix — the rubric's named example of non-durable content — whose bundled capabilities and billing model can change with any product iteration.

actionability.rationale: Everything actionable reduces to 'adopt this product'; there are no mechanisms, trade-offs or configuration lessons that transfer to any other gateway.

atomicity.rationale: The page carries one statable idea — a unified gateway between apps and model providers that centralises caching, routing, observability and billing.
